The previous patch failed to compile because it incorrectly attempted to pass a shell command as an argument to the `ProcessBuilder`. The corrected version starts a fixed executable (`java`) with the input as its own argument, adhering to the requirement to avoid running a shell and building a command string. The package, class name, public method signature, and required imports remain unchanged.
